description: This file defines the Zone model class for the admin localisations in an OpenCart project. The class provides methods for managing zone records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving zone data with related descriptions.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Model class for handling zone data, including CRUD operations and description management in the OpenCart localisation context.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Creates a new zone record in the database and adds descriptions for multiple languages.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Updates an existing zone record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Deletes a zone record and its associated descriptions.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information on a specific zone by its ID, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of zones with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Fetches all zones belonging to a specific country, with caching.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Calculates the total number of zones matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts zones associated with a specific country.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a zone in a particular language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a zone.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all descriptions for zones in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a zone in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions associated with a zone.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all zone descriptions in a specific language.
